digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI / Gerrit Verified workflow
propositions: Ubuntu Verified jobs consume 30.2 runner-minutes per run and remain material queue contention despite prior macOS latency RCA optimization

Repeated YAML parsing in bridge-cadence exhaustive 1,440-minute check consumes 100-130s per test; hoisting the parsed schedule reuses invariant I/O without removing assertions, saving ~5.7 runner-minutes

Render-unit and render-hardening suites invoke Pandoc 3,400+ times across corpus boundary tests but legacy assertion requires only existential witness probes; replacing redundant legacy subprocess with immutable golden fixtures preserves all 884 real-product conversions and boundary coverage

AST provenance fixture setup repeats ~9.5M walk iterations and caller-discovery per test session, adding 46-49s; indexing enclosing callers and parent relationships once per process preserves exact 24 assertion tuples and all guards

Cancellation-aware job status predicates must replace always() predicates in full-route reusable jobs to allow GitHub superseded-patchset cancellation, removing 20-25 minute same-change admission blocking without changing test content or coverage
